alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.31% (+54bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-09
Current:  2.31%
90d low:  1.77%
Move:     +54bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield jumped to 2.31pp as of 2026-07-09, up 0.54pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.77pp.

内容:
10年期实际（TIPS）收益率在 2026-07-09 升至 2.31pp，较过去90天低点 1.77pp 上升了 0.54pp。

Why it matters:
Real yields near a decade-plus high sharply raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and make risk-free debt more attractive than speculative infrastructure bets. A move of this size at 2x the trigger threshold escalates C10 to HIGH, signaling tightening financial conditions are now a live threat to the AI-capex thesis.

影响:
实际利率逼近多年高位，会大幅提高对长久期 AI capex 现金流的贴现率，也让无风险债券相对投机性基础设施投资更具吸引力。此次波动幅度达到触发阈值的两倍，使 C10 升级为 HIGH，说明融资环境收紧已经对 AI capex 逻辑构成现实威胁。

alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-07
Current:  2.30%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +58bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.30% on 2026-07-07, up 0.58pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72%, crossing C10's 2x escalation trigger.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-07 升至 2.30%，较过去 90 天低点 1.72% 上升了 0.58 个百分点，触发了 C10 的 2 倍升级阈值。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — this is the kind of move that historically precedes de-rating of high-multiple growth names, including hyperscalers funding the buildout.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高 AI capex 长久期现金流的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融条件——历史上这类走势往往是高估值成长股（包括为算力建设融资的大型科技公司）估值回调的前兆。

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-06升至2.24%，较过去90天低点1.72%上升了0.52个百分点。

Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — a fast spike like this pressures the same high-multiple, capex-heavy names the bubble-stress thesis is watching, and pairs with a stronger dollar as a tightening signal.

实际收益率快速上升会提高对AI资本开支这类长久期现金流的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融环境——这类急速飙升会给高估值、重资本开支的公司带来压力，也往往与美元走强一起构成收紧信号。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.26% (+54bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-02
Current:  2.26%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +54bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield rose to 2.26% on 2026-07-02, up 0.54 points from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72%.

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-02升至2.26%，较过去90天低点1.72%上升了0.54个百分点。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields tighten financial conditions and raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex bets; a move this size makes leveraged infrastructure buildouts materially more expensive to finance.

影响:
实际收益率上升会收紧金融条件，提高对AI资本开支这类长久期押注的贴现率；这个幅度的上升会让加杠杆的基础设施建设融资成本明显上升。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] U.S. court doubts DRAM collusion as HBM shift explains price surge - CHOSUNBIZ - Chosunbiz
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 21:00:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 U.S. court doubts DRAM collusion as HBM shift explains price surge - CHOSUNBIZ - Chosunbiz U.S. court doubts DRAM collusion as HBM shift explains price surge - CHOSUNBIZ  Chosunbiz ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A U.S. court expressed skepticism toward DRAM price-fixing/collusion claims, with the price surge instead attributed to the HBM supply shift. 内容: 一家美国法院对 DRAM 价格操纵（合谋）指控表示怀疑，认为价格上涨的真正原因是 HBM 需求带来的供应结构转移。 Why it matters: Rules out one bearish narrative (cartel behavior) but confirms the underlying signal: HBM demand from AI accelerators is pulling DRAM/NAND capacity away from commodity memory, tightening supply and pushing prices up across the board. 影响: 这排除了一种利空叙事（厂商合谋垄断价格），但确认了背后真正的信号：AI 加速卡对 HBM 的需求正在挤占 DRAM/NAND 的普通产能，导致整体内存供应趋紧、价格上涨。
